title: Damage Messages
body:
Syntax: (automatic during combat)

Description: Every combat damage word corresponds to the actual damage dealt. The word is colored from a broad palette so you can judge a hit at a glance. The exact scale is:

            0-1 damage  &[245]TRIVIAL&x
            2-4 damage  &[110]GLANCING&x
            5-9 damage  &[123]STINGING&x
          10-19 damage  &[39]BONE-JARRING&x
          20-34 damage  &[75]RIB-RATTLING&x
          35-54 damage  &[135]THUNDEROUS&x
          55-79 damage  &[171]BRUTAL&x
         80-119 damage  &[168]FEROCIOUS&x
        120-179 damage  &[174]CRUSHING&x
        180-259 damage  &[215]SAVAGE&x
        260-399 damage  &[190]MANGLE-INDUCING&x
        400-599 damage  &[220]DEVASTATING&x
        600-899 damage  &[214]ANNIHILATING&x
      900-1,299 damage  &[208]OBLITERATING&x
    1,300-1,999 damage  &[202]CATASTROPHIC&x
    2,000-2,999 damage  &[196]CATACLYSMIC&x
    3,000-4,999 damage  &[197]WORLD-BREAKING&x
    5,000-7,499 damage  &[93]REALITY-RENDING&x
    7,500-9,999 damage  &[201]REALITY-SHATTERING&x
        10,000+ damage  &[213]EXTINCTION-LEVEL&x

Hits beyond 10,000 stay EXTINCTION-LEVEL. Damaging jutsu base hits climb this word ladder with their unlock level: level 75 reaches CATASTROPHIC, and level 100 reaches EXTINCTION-LEVEL. Multi-strike jutsu split their base across strikes. Bonuses and defenses can move a final hit to another word. Damage words appear in combat instead of raw numbers.

Date: 2026-10-03
